mechanism_narrative: The continued drop in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT signals weaker daytime commuting, which suppresses nearby retail visits and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall below its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remaining more negative than in the last observed week.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in RESIDENTIAL alongside falling TRANSIT means more time spent at home and fewer discretionary trips, which reduces retail-and-recreation mobility within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL is above +12 and TRANSIT is below -45 in the same week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above +12 and TRANSIT remains below -45.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM stays near its current mild decline while PARKS remain depressed, discretionary trips are weak and retail demand follows lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM staying between -10 and 0 and PARKS staying below 10.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week break below -45 in TRANSIT marks a fresh mobility contraction that reduces shopping access and pulls RETAIL_REC lower over the next one to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -45 after being above -45 the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within the next 7 days after TRANSIT crosses below -45 from above.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS jump while WORKPLACES stay weak, outdoor leisure substitutes for shopping trips and retail mobility falls over the following month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days even though PARKS remain above 20 and WORKPLACES remain below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent recovery in PARKS combined with stable GROCERY_PHARM implies leisure and errands are absorbing outside trips, which leaves less room for retail visits and lowers RETAIL_REC with a two-week lag.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above 25 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline over the next 14 days after PARKS remain above 25 for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Higher RESIDENTIAL together with lower WORKPLACES reflects a substitution toward staying home, and that substitution should compress discretionary shopping mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not remain below its prior 4-week average while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and WORKPLACES stays depressed.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both stay below their recent levels, the commuting network is still contracting, and retail mobility will be lower over the next month than over the last month.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -45 and WORKPLACES remains below -25 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES stay below the stated thresholds for two weeks.
